description: Asks what the byte-oriented InStrB and RightB return or raise (they are not asked elsewhere): over literal operands (start positions, compare modes, an empty operand, Null, a number, a non-Latin character, an astral pair, an embedded U+0000) and over the stored values of Tx (InStrB(T, 'b'), InStrB(T, Chr(0)), RightB(T, 1), RightB(T, 2), with LenB(T) beside). Each literal call is its own snapshot; the stored-value forms are one snapshot each, ordered by ID. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
